content:
Priya Nair: quick async — can someone confirm ownership for the Optimize toolkit quant recs for small-medium models? need a green owner to unblock the delivery checklist.
Maya Patel: I can take the owner tag for the quant profiles portion. will coordinate with infra on the tuning.
Li Wei: thx Maya. I'll handle batching/caching suggestions and perf sigs for p50/p95.
Priya Nair: awesome. @Maya @Li — primary deliverable: a recommended profile + rollout guidance (canary -> scale) and a short regression test plan.
Oscar Reid: heads up — infra is still waiting on the final KV cache API changes (PR #4421). until that merges, caching TTL behavior is inconsistent across replicas.
Jonas Berg: pinging infra-ci for a status of that PR and any rollback risks.
infra-ci: PR #4421: running integration tests (shard-3) — 17/24 passed, 3 flaky failures being investigated, ETA ~2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya Patel: noted. we can split work: I'll draft quant profiles and fallback policy that doesn't require new cache API (conservative TTL), Li can prototype batching params that are safe without cache.
Li Wei: prototype posted in repo under optkit/configs/qtt-experiments: `batch_size: 8
max_latency_ms: 50
prefix_cache: false
hard_ttl_sec: 60` — this should avoid relying on new KV semantics.
Priya Nair: perfect. can you both add a short smoke test matrix? we need p50/p95 token latency, token/sec, and quality delta on eval set.
Maya Patel: adding smoke tests. quick question: which eval set do we use for the small models? existing inference/evals/smallbench_v2.json or new slices?
Oscar Reid: smallbench_v2 is fine, but add a 'low-context' slice (<=64 tokens) and a 'long-context' 512 slice so we catch cache/kv impacts.
Priya Nair: good call. also flag any quant profile that increases hallucination rate > 0.5% vs baseline.
Jonas Berg: infra note — if PR #4421 is delayed past EOD, we'll need to gate cache-dependent rollout and apply a feature-flagged knob in routing to force cache=false for Dedicated.
Maya Patel: will add a feature-flag toggle in the rollout docs. sample canary plan: 10% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h with metrics check at each step.
Li Wei: I'll add batching smoke: run 1000 requests with synthetic mix, measure throughput and retry rate. post results to the optkit/metrics channel.
Priya Nair: timeline? we want docs + config + smoke results by tomorrow 10:00 PT to stay on the sprint. is that realistic?
Maya Patel: yes if infra CI finishes in 2h. otherwise I'll mark the docs as 'safe-without-cache' and we can merge.
infra-ci: update: investigating flaky hangs in shard-3 worker; workaround branch `ci/fix-shard3-hang` reduces flakiness in local repro.
deploy-bot: reminder: branch protection requires 2 approvers for optkit/* changes.
Oscar Reid: flag — we need @security review on the fallback TTL change, since it touches cache semantics for sensitive tokens.
Priya Nair: @Jonas can you queue security? also who will file the regression alert rule once we merge? we should auto-fire if quality delta >0.5% or p95 latency regresses >20%.
Jonas Berg: will request security review. I'll also create the SLO alert PR (optkit/alerts/regression.yml) once smoke results are in.
Maya Patel: assigning tasks: Maya -> quant profiles + docs; Li -> batching configs + smoke; Jonas -> infra/security coordination + alerts; Priya -> rollout owner + merge decision.
Li Wei: I'll post the smoke-run logs and a short summary in this thread when done.
Priya Nair: thanks team — please ping here for blockers. small checklist for tomorrow: configs merged, smoke results, alerts PR opened, canary docs uploaded. :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: noted. will update the docs link here when ready.
Li Wei: smoke finished: throughput +12%, p95 +6% (safe), quality delta 0.12% (within threshold). logs: https://internal-ci/optkit/smoke/3087 — attaching summary next.
Priya Nair: great — that looks within tolerances. Jonas, proceed with alerts PR.
Jonas Berg: opened PR #4510 for alerts, and flagged security reviewer.
Priya Nair: closing loop — infra CI passed on `ci/fix-shard3-hang`, PR #4421 merged at 3087654500, we can enable cache-safe rollout. thanks everyone, we'll track post-canary metrics in optkit/metrics. :tada:
